blocks.title: Application Support Engineer
blocks.source_text: Application Support Engineer with 3+ years across application support and IT operations, including production SaaS, Microsoft 365, and internal integrations. Resolved 200+ tickets with sub-90-minute average resolution and built Loavenly, a production multi-tenant SaaS platform, specializing in SQL, log analysis, API debugging, and root cause analysis.
facts: 3+ years application support and IT operations

blocks.title: OIG ticket support
blocks.source_text: Resolved 200+ Jira support tickets across agency management SaaS, internal integrations, and Microsoft 365, maintaining sub-90-minute average resolution for routine support issues.

blocks.title: OIG incident and API debugging
blocks.source_text: Investigated production incidents using log analysis, SQL queries, and API debugging with Postman, isolating root cause and validating fixes in live environments.

blocks.title: OIG ETL and carrier feeds
blocks.source_text: Monitored nightly ETL jobs syncing data from 22 carrier/vendor feeds into a production database, triaging failures and building a Python reconciliation script that reduced monthly close prep from 5 hours to 40 minutes.

blocks.title: OIG identity and provisioning
blocks.source_text: Administered Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, including MFA, RBAC, and license management, and used Microsoft Graph API and PowerShell to streamline user provisioning across 20+ SaaS apps, reducing onboarding from 4 hours to 45 minutes.

blocks.title: OIG carrier integrations
blocks.source_text: Supported webhook and carrier integration workflows for the agency management system, debugging payload, authentication, and data-sync failures using Postman and structured logs.

blocks.title: CSULB operations support
blocks.source_text: Provided first-line application support for Astra Schedule, EMS, and campus access control systems, resolving room scheduling conflicts, user access issues, classroom AV incidents, and operational system disruptions during after-hours campus operations.

blocks.title: CSULB documentation and escalation
blocks.source_text: Maintained incident documentation, escalation notes, and recurring issue tracking while coordinating with campus IT and third-party vendors.

blocks.title: Loavenly platform
blocks.source_text: Built, deployed, and operate a production multi-tenant SaaS platform supporting client intake, inventory tracking, reporting, and RBAC across six food bank locations.
